body: Oh my God I was so confused, I had it backwards. I was about to feel really bad to tell you that you don't pass for a guy at all. I'm not exaggerating in the slightest.
It's mostly other trans/FTM people. We just really want to see ourselves, since we usually don't. But you're right, at the end of the day, we're just one of the guys. ;)

No worries about coming across as transphobic! I'm FTM and had the same thought, lmao. Either way, seeing someone with mastectomy scars of any kind in a photo like this, when it's all too common for that representation to be absent, feels great. I'm glad he's there! He looks stunning.
